description: Match a plain-language task description against public Toolfound catalogue evidence. Use it when someone asks which tool can do a specific job, such as converting invoices or scheduling social posts, and you want listed candidates rather than a general web search. Returns up to a handful of matching listings with name, tagline, listing URL, pricing model, the terms that matched and any limitations. Results are not personal recommendations and unknown capabilities remain unknown.

pricing.description: Optional pricing filter. free keeps only free tools, free_or_freemium also keeps tools with a free tier, any applies no filter. Listings with unknown pricing are excluded when a filter is set.

task.description: The job to get done, described in everyday words, for example send invoices to clients. Name the outcome, not a product.

name: toolfound_find_by_task
title: Find public tools by task
